cc0f55c9.text:
Elf,

As a guest of the Horde, the Warchief has given you leave to travel freely throughout Horde territory.

Use this guide to find your way around our lands.
cc0f55c9.title: Advisor Nazgrel's Instructions

10378|4fa5b9c3.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|4fa5b9c3.text: Where can I send you today $c?

10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

10540|5004ab66.name: Vol'jin
10540|5004ab66.text:
Ah yes, I heard of the Windshapers. It be good to be meetin' you now.

You know, my people been fighting elves for thousands of years. If you be half as fierce as your cousins from Darnassus or Quel'Thalas, the Darkspear would be glad to call you friend.

I be wishin' you well in your travels, $c. We Darkspear know all too well what it's like to have no home, so I hope you be finding what your people need to save yours.

10540|7c6995ef.name: Vol'jin
10540|7c6995ef.text: I am Vol'jin, of the Darkspear. Do you be friend, or enemy?

14726|65d66388.name: Rashona Straglash
14726|65d66388.text:
In these trying times, a simple donation of cloth can go a long way to help those less fortunate than ourselves.  Cloth goes a long way to making garments and bandages - both important for the war effort!

If you are interested in donating cloth pieces to the orcs of Orgrimmar, I will gladly accept them and make sure you receive the proper recognition for doing so.

For the Horde!

14728|9fb0176c.name: Rumstag Proudstrider
14728|9fb0176c.text:
Hail sister... I'd like a moment of your time, if I may.

We tauren have endured much in our trials and tribulations in establishing our homeland.  We now find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  If you have the materials to spare, I ask that you please donate them.  You certainly would earn the gratitude of tauren everywhere in helping us out!

15350|44b49612.name: Horde Warbringer
15350|44b49612.text: War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

2215|dc484bb4.name: High Executor Darthalia
2215|dc484bb4.text: In order to serve the Dark Lady and Varimathras we need to advance the front on the Human Infestation.

223|23e08fe6.name: Dan Golthas
223|23e08fe6.text: When I clawed my way out of the grave, I thought my family would welcome me with open arms. Instead, they drove me from the village, screaming in a language I could no longer understand.

2388|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2410|8b3451aa.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
2410|8b3451aa.text: My studies take me far from the Under City, but to truly learn one must be near to the source of knowledge.

250929|4b2429f8.name: Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct
250929|4b2429f8.text: <As you approach the enormous cyclone construct, you hear a faint buzzing emanating from beneath its massive armor plates. If you listen carefully, you think you might be able to hear a few words being formed but they are too distorted to make out.>

251684|5d8faa22.name: Strange Hermit
251684|5d8faa22.text: H-Hello. You'll have to excuse me, I'm used to your kind running from me.

251968|88447c8b.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
251968|88447c8b.text: Greetings, I am Ayessa Dawnsinger, the current Grand Skyseer of the Windshapers. What may I do for you?

251968|97b43995.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
251968|97b43995.text:
If the High Order gave any mind at all to actually solving the problems we face and spent less time obsessing over the old magic, we'd be in a far better position as a people. It was highborne magic that brought about the ruin of the kaldorei to begin with. Those self-absorbed fools seek to repeat those mistakes!

The fact that they attempted to make peace with the cult is bad enough, but spilling Windshaper blood is what is truly unforgivable. Were it not for the imminent threat of the cult, I'd gather up our forces and go put an end to Elaadrin and the High Order once and for all.

251968|ca320a53.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
251968|ca320a53.text: Hmm, I see. Very well then, $c. The Windshapers will provide aid. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

252359|80b579b6.name: Lotheluum Starbreeze
252359|80b579b6.text: Our kind are rare these days, but there are those who still dream in emerald amongst the Shen'dorei.

252377|fe3406a9.name: Seena Skybreaker
252377|fe3406a9.text: The warrior who flinches is the warrior who dies. If you would look death in the face as a warrior, I will teach you how not to flinch.

252379|87ef59fc.name: Eltheen Nightbreeze
252379|87ef59fc.text:
Slay your enemies and swoon your paramours with this one weird trick.

If you follow the path of the rogue, I can teach you... for a cost, of course.

252382|4d87d665.name: Sessaria Skystride
252382|4d87d665.text:
The spirits of the wind may have left us, but the power of the elements is not entirely out of reach for those with the patience to seek them out.

If you are initiated in the ways of the shaman, I can help you grasp them.

252383|28d94b03.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|28d94b03.text:
I suppose that is true. I and the rest of my elites used to belong to an order known as the Empyrean Blades. We were the personal guard of our former leader, the Shal'nan. 

In the current, uncertain times we do what we can to help lead the peacekeepers' citizen militia, since we are the closest thing to professional soldiers left on Zephras.

252383|5676c909.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|5676c909.text:
<Valennia looks away briefly before looking hesitantly back in your direction.>

The Shal'nan was the very best of us. It was he who stood up for our people against madness and oppression in Eldre'Thalas nearly ten thousand years ago. It was the Shal'nan who led us across the uncharted sea to escape the murderous vengeance of our ancient enemies.

It was the Shal'nan who brokered the pact of friendship with the wind spirits that allowed us to ascend to Skywall... and survive.

He was ever the servant leader to his people, even after he abdicated his position of power and retired.

252383|8d2a94b9.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|8d2a94b9.text:
If I knew that then I suspect that life here on Zephras would be much, much easier. So many of our struggles and conflicts revolve around that very mystery.

I appreciate your curiosity on this matter but I'm afraid that is all I have to say about this for today.

252383|e7690d8a.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|e7690d8a.text:
The Peacekeepers can't hope to muster the numbers needed for an outright assault on the shrine. Without the Windshapers and the High Order bolstering our numbers, we stand no chance. They both pledged their aid when we need it. Now is the time.

Unfortunately, some recent events have led to outright bloodshed between the two factions, and tensions are high.

How do you feel about a bit of diplomacy?

252383|f5d2c665.name: Valennia Stormfist
252383|f5d2c665.text:
I might be the only living shen'dorei left amongst our people who had more than a handful of words with him.

I served him as the captain of his Empyrean Blades for nearly nine centuries, right up until... he left us.

Even still, I can't rightly claim that I "knew" him. He was ever a reserved and solitary man. He spent most of his time alone or in communion with the spirits in the spires high above the Shrine of the Four Winds... the place that the cult now calls the 'Shrine of Akir'.

252389|2becf397.name: Quel'ana Quickgale
252389|2becf397.text:
The hunters and rangers of Zephras have never been more needed. The winds grow ever harsher, and the magic that sustains our island is fading. The wilds have never been more wild, and people like me are needed to keep our people safe.

If you have the proper aptitude as a $c, I can give you the tools to survive the wilds.

252392|720694b4.name: Orsaan Dalewind
252392|720694b4.text:
Greetings, young $c. Welcome to the hall of the Tradesman's Guild. Resources are tight on Zephras right now, but you should be able to find a variety of materials and wares here to keep you in top adventuring form.

Please let me know if you have any questions.

252448|14de7cf6.name: Alvarion Windfield
252448|14de7cf6.text: It's always great to see you, $N.

252448|aadf0ebc.name: Alvarion Windfield
252448|aadf0ebc.text: <The man lying before you shifts uncomfortably. He's recovering from some very nasty wounds.>

252475|3e3dd1cf.name: Elaadrin Evengale
252475|3e3dd1cf.text:
<Elaadrin eyes you with barely-contained hatred.> 

You would dare step foot into our sanctum after spilling High Order blood? You are very brave, or very stupid. The High Order does not forgive, nor do we forget.

Someday, you will pay for your crimes in blood.

252475|b7dd6ea5.name: Elaadrin Evengale
252475|b7dd6ea5.text:
Hmm, I see. Very well then, $c. The High Order will assist the Peacekeepers. Please inform Valennia that she can count on us for this fight.

<Elaadrin lowers his voice dangerously.>

Do not mistake our willing cooperation for any sort of clemency. You owe the High Order blood, and we always collect on our debts.

252476|fcd03afb.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
252476|fcd03afb.text: It is vital that we learn more about what the cult is planning, and with the turncoat dead, the information may have died with him...

252800|d3392a1d.name: Aamelia Windfield
252800|d3392a1d.text: The Windfield Orchard has seen better days...

253372|4b6a69db.name: Dead Cultist
253372|4b6a69db.text: <This cultist is dead. Upon close inspection, you notice that he seems to be clutching something to his chest, almost as if he was protecting it.>

253576|febbe4e4.name: Hyusaa Quickbreeze
253576|febbe4e4.text:
Most of the cultists at the Sanctum of Storms seem to have come out to respond to our attack. I never would have expected this to go so well. This was almost too easy...

I think that the Windshapers and High Order have made their push. Valennia should be with them. You should head inside and find her. We'll stay here and keep watch while Valennia and the others finish what they came here to do.

253590|2061ff16.name: Valennia Stormfist
253590|2061ff16.text: <Valennia is severely wounded and is barely holding on to consciousness.>

253849|6ace422f.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
253849|6ace422f.text:
Lorthuna is performing some sort of ritual up there. She may be trying to bring down the wards!

The help we sent for has not yet arrived, but we'll just have to manage with what we have. When you are ready, let me know and we'll go confront her.

254100|1ab538e5.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|1ab538e5.text:
The Al'Aketh cult is becoming a major problem and the peacekeepers seem powerless to stop them. We can only hope that the Windshapers and the High Order can put aside their bickering and work with the peacekeepers to protect us.

I certainly don't want to join a cult!

254100|6be7d7dd.name: Zephras Citizen
254100|6be7d7dd.text:
The Al'Aketh cult claims that Al'Akir the "Windlord" will save us from our current woes here on Zephras. If Al'Akir is real and really is the ruler of Skywall, why did the wind spirits refuse to speak of him for so long?

Either he isn't real, or even worse, he's real and he's not as benevolent as the cult claims him to be. Either way, nothing about what the cult is doing is good for us normal folk.

254151|197a65c0.name: Vayn Moongaze
254151|197a65c0.text: The Nightclaw do not take kindly to reckless intruders. Tread carefully while in Shadowgale, $c.

254151|20a1483e.name: Vayn Moongaze
254151|20a1483e.text:
You've earned a degree of trust amongst the Nightclaw, $c. We don't have much to offer you as a reward, but we have managed to scavenge a number of crafting plans from the ruins of Ban'aethal.

The magesmiths of Ban'aethal were widely regarded to be the best artisans in all of the $R Isles. The Nightclaw are naturalists, not crafters, so these records are of little use to us.

Continue to prove yourself to be a valuable ally, and I would make these secrets available to you.

254345|fb513610.name: Syriel Nightrain
254345|fb513610.text: I hope that your interruption is for a good cause. I was in the middle of some important work.

254411|0e051c59.name: Quel'dora Quickgale
254411|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

255940|9cc50b7d.name: Donaal Downbreeze
255940|9cc50b7d.text: Welcome to the Calmbreeze Inn, traveler. Would you like some refreshment?

256083|6571d699.name: Riaani Nightwind
256083|6571d699.text: <Riaani seems to be intently focused on his work on the wind construct.>

256247|c69f0372.name: Belathaan Brightwish
256247|c69f0372.text: What are you doing here? Quickly, leave this place now. You are going to ruin everything!

256635|824cc722.name: Peacekeeper
256635|824cc722.text: Adventurer! The wind bridge leading to the other spire is unstable. You may need to wait here with me until it returns.

257003|ec1a6e0b.name: Ishlee Breezewhisper
257003|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

257004|c65683ed.name: Eaysaa Brightgust
257004|c65683ed.text: Winds tidings. What can I help you with?

257006|53a09e6f.name: Nyalah Brightfire
257006|53a09e6f.text: Y garde bor hir uden algos me nuff nostyec lon aldonoth, far Y nagan Y borne eynes nud danagarde lo rothas melka.

257944|37940c1f.name: Elegael Thornpaw
257944|37940c1f.text: I cannot believe we were taken by surprise by the Al'Aketh. They have never been hostile to us before, but with their ambush they injured many of my kin. I swear I will get revenge for the fallen and wounded druids of my den. Mark my words, they will pay.

258130|5a52f936.name: Jorel Windsinger
258130|5a52f936.text:
<Before you lies the corpse of Jorel Windsinger.

Deep lacerations are cut into his legs, and lightning burns scorch his fur.

It is clear he put up a fight before succumbing to his wounds.>

259012|517aef13.name: Ealaane Nimbuswalker
259012|517aef13.text: All of the $r islands became destabilized and began to move apart a few years ago. If that wasn't bad enough, now large pieces of Zephras are beginning to fall away. It's hard to imagine your home falling into the sky, but that is my reality now.

259013|6750d3f2.name: Resaan Nimbuswalker
259013|6750d3f2.text:
<Before you lies a $r; his body is mangled and bruised but still recognizable. It is clear he met a gruesome end while attempting to flee.

It appears that all of his belongings are still on his body, and a half-filled crate nearby lies spilled on the ground.>

264078|adb68b1b.name: Sutara Plainstalker
264078|adb68b1b.text:
It is my honor to handle supply and provisioning for the Earthen Ring. 

My stock is limited at present, but check back with me often and I may have new equipment and supplies available for purchase.

275270|56f11671.name: Windshapers Dockmaster
275270|56f11671.text: This skycutter will take you right to the wondrous open plains of Mulgore.

276171|1e85fa3a.name: Oura Stormspinner
276171|1e85fa3a.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3050|57562eaa.name: Veren Tallstrider
3050|57562eaa.text: The tauren are sons and daughters of the Earthmother, and we show respect to all her children.  Even the beasts we slay are cherished, as their bodies give nourishment and their skins provide warmth.

3057|114886ab.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|114886ab.text:
Muln Earthfury has told me much of the Windshapers and I am proud to open the lands--and skies--of Mulgore to your people.

The tauren and the $R are both children of this land. Kalimdor. 

I hope that your people are able to find what they are looking for here and that you are able to save your homeland. In the meantime, it is my hope that you are able to learn more of the land that your ancestors used to call home.

Please make yourself at home here in Thunder Bluff, and may the Earth Mother bless your journey.

3057|690a7170.name: Cairne Bloodhoof
3057|690a7170.text:
Greetings young one, and welcome to Thunder Bluff.  You'll find safe refuge from the burdens of the world here.  All denizens of the Horde are welcome here.

The spirits of the present and past come alive here in this sacred place, my friend.  Honor them, and in doing so honor yourself.

3230|3b64a31f.name: Nazgrel
3230|3b64a31f.text:
<Nazgrel grunts as he sizes you up.>

High elves, here in Orgrimmar. I'd never bet on such a thing happening in my lifetime, but at this point nothing is surprising to me.

Yes, the Warchief instructed me to draft up instructions for you. Take this letter and follow the instructions within. Conduct yourself with honor and show due deference when you meet with our leaders, elf.

Once you've finished your journey, return to the Warchief.

3230|8d5031bd.name: Nazgrel
3230|8d5031bd.text: Mind yourself in the presence of the Warchief, $c. The Kor'kron will suffer no insolence or insult here.

3296|1988a17b.name: Orgrimmar Grunt
3296|1988a17b.text: Go to the $C's Hall in the Valley of Honor, west of the Coliseum.  Talk to Ormak Grimshot there.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3309|ae78a458.name: Karus
3309|ae78a458.text: Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

3314|1676cade.name: Urtharo
3314|1676cade.text: Tell me what you want, and make it quick.

3318|2f8d506f.name: Koma
3318|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3318|6b36598f.name: Koma
3318|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3390|eb12150e.name: Apothecary Helbrim
3390|eb12150e.text: The Barrens holds a wealth of substances for which we, the apothecaries or Lordaeron, may find use.

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3406|08e320c2.name: Xor'juul
3406|08e320c2.text: What kin I do for ya, mon?

3407|2a1798f1.name: Sian'dur
3407|2a1798f1.text: Come learn the ways of the $c. Pride, honor, and tradition.

3419|dabc0513.name: Apothecary Zamah
3419|dabc0513.text: For our people to survive, we must study the ways of nature and learn its secrets.

3429|4e7d06f7.name: Thork
3429|4e7d06f7.text:
Welcome to the Crossroads, $c. My name is Thork--I lead the defenses here in the name of the Warchief.

Please, feel free to make yourself at home. As long as you mind your business, no one should have any problem with you taking up some space.

There are many threats to our safety here. If you've already become familiar with the lay of the land, speak to the others here--perhaps they have tasks for you to do.

3430|0e16a4d2.name: Mangletooth
3430|0e16a4d2.text:
You! $R! Come here. <snort>

Time is short, and my end <snort> is near. Mangletooth shall win; you will see. <snort>

My capture can still aid <snort> my people. The Razormane tribe is more powerful than the Bristlebacks!

The Horde looks to find out who leads the raids on their people. You <snort> shall aid Mangletooth in return for the information only I know. Mangletooth can help you! <snort> But you must help Mangletooth.

3432|c1a3099b.name: Mankrik
3432|c1a3099b.text:
I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.

He claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

3433|4ec00f6f.name: Tatternack Steelforge
3433|4ec00f6f.text:
The Warchief has instructed me to study all kinds of weapons and armor. He has sent me here to the hub of both the tauren and orc cultures in the Barrens to meet as many travelers as possible, and to learn about the cultures of the Barrens.

He feels there's something to be learned from even the most pathetic of cultures... like the quilboar or centaur.

3442|6ac7df7d.name: Sputtervalve
3442|6ac7df7d.text:
See, the Venture Company's new shredder is better than my latest, from the interchangeable hands to the control grips! My boss has given me a pretty strict deadline, but my boys and I couldn't come up with anything.

Nothing was working, so we decided to "borrow" one of their prototypes. I sent Wizzlecrank to the Sludge Fen to steal one, but he hasn't gotten back yet!

3442|ef9d74c5.name: Sputtervalve
3442|ef9d74c5.text: Director Riddlevox put me in charge of the Union's shredder development program. Few months on the job and I'm already in hot water! I could use your help, $N!

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4949|9a2b62b8.name: Thrall
4949|9a2b62b8.text:
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, $N. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

Understand this well. This is the new Horde, not some demon-spawned army who lack freewill.

5624|cfc403d6.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|cfc403d6.text: Killian Hagey teach skinning in Rogues' Quarter on inner ring.

5811|aea93ec3.name: Kamari
5811|aea93ec3.text: Too bad we can't skin the humans and their allies. All that skin is just going to waste. Still, who'd want to wear the flimsy leather you could make out of it?

1061-accept.name: Zor Lonetree
1061-accept.text:
The spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains are angered, for goblins and their servants are plundering and burning the land.  So the land has cried out, and those who listen for such things... have heard.

Seereth Stonebreak, a promising shaman of the Horde, was sent to Stonetalon.  She reports massive deforestation at the hands of the goblins, and requests aid.

Meet Seereth in Stonetalon.  To reach her, follow the road west of the Barrens' Crossroads.  She is camped near the Greatwood Vale.
1061-accept.title: The Spirits of Stonetalon

1069-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1069-accept.text:
Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay!  The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs.

I smell an opportunity!

In Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider.  Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle!

In Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain.

In Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
1069-accept.title: Deepmoss Spider Eggs

1361-accept.name: Krusk
1361-accept.text:
A warrior of the Horde, Regthar Deathgate, is recruiting agents for a mission into the land of Desolace.  Speak with him if you wish to volunteer.  He is stationed in the Barrens, in a series of bunkers west of the Crossroads.

And sharpen your weapons.  Desolace is a place torn by war.
1361-accept.title: Regthar Deathgate

1483-accept.name: Sputtervalve
1483-accept.text:
The Venture Company stole many of the best goblin minds, but from time to time, we get the opportunity to steal some back.

A while ago, the Venture Company outfit in the Stonetalon Mountains hired Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle--a gnome! Their other engineer, Ziz Fizziks, was so taken aback by this, he pleaded with me to find him new employment with the Tinkers' Union. I set him on a few tasks, but he might need help.

Maybe you could look in on him for me? He's stationed at the western edge of Windshear Crag.
1483-accept.title: Ziz Fizziks

1491-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
1491-accept.text:
Ok, so the raptor horns didn't work so well.  But that's all right -- no one got rich on their first try!  And besides, I think I found something that'll work even better in my smart drinks!

There is a substance called Wailing Essence, and I think it is the cause of the strange plants and animals in the Barrens.  Get me some and I'll try it in my drink!

I heard the essence gathers in ectoplasmic creatures in the Wailing Caverns to the west.  Hunt those creatures and gather the essence.
1491-accept.title: Smart Drinks

1492-accept.name: Apothecary Helbrim
1492-accept.text:
I have need to send a crate of potions, reagents and other items to my associates in the Old World. Little time I have to actually see them to the dock at Ratchet, and the last caravan has already left.

If you could, please take this to Wharfmaster Dizzywig. He will ensure that it is placed on the next boat to Blackwater Cove.
1492-accept.title: Wharfmaster Dizzywig

1492-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
1492-complete.text:
A small enough crate. Yes, I should be able to find room for this aboard the ship. It sails with the next tide, I trust this is soon enough? Excellent. Let me just enter it into my ledger.

All taken care of! Good day to you, $c.
1492-complete.title: Wharfmaster Dizzywig

1492-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
1492-progress.text: You seek passage on the next ship, or have some item you wish to send aboard it?
1492-progress.title: Wharfmaster Dizzywig

264-accept.name: Clarice Foster
264-accept.text:
Filthy scum! Leaves me for his damn crusade. Because "the Light is the most important thing we have against the threats the undead pose."

Well, what about his children?! What about ME?! Night after night I sat patiently waiting for him... always second to his blasted duty!

Well, witness what "justice" brings you, $N! He's dead and I'm bearing the very thing he was trying to stop!

Take this piece of junk and put it on his tomb at the Sepulcher. I want nothing to do with it anymore... or him!
264-accept.title: Until Death Do Us Part

3281-accept.name: Gazrog
3281-accept.text:
You may have killed the raptors, but the silver they stole must be recovered!  I have reports that the raptors have a large grouping of nests south of Ratchet, known as the Raptor Grounds.  It is likely that they brought our stolen silver there.

Go to this raptor haven and search for the stolen silver.  When you find it, return it to me.
3281-accept.title: Stolen Silver

3921-accept.name: Sputtervalve
3921-accept.text:
I think I might have broken that Samophlange.  That's not good, because I already told some colleagues in Undermine about it and they were very intrigued.  We must find a way to fix it!

Take the broken samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket, just south of Mor'shan Rampart, the horde outpost between the Barrens and Ashenvale.  She is very clever and inquisitive.  If you show her the samophlange I bet she'd jump at the chance to fix it.
3921-accept.title: Wenikee Boltbucket

3921-complete.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3921-complete.text:
Oh, what's this?  A samophlange, you say?  What's a samophlange??

Ah... but look at the way it moves when you handle it.  And there's the sound of intricate gears inside.  Oh my!  I want to fix it and see what it does, don't you??
3921-complete.title: Wenikee Boltbucket

3921-progress.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3921-progress.text: I'm very busy with my work, $c.  Unless you have something for me, it'd be best if you moved along...
3921-progress.title: Wenikee Boltbucket

3922-accept.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3922-accept.text:
I want to fix this samophlange, but to do that I'm going to need some supplies.  I ran out of seventeen-point-five gauge nugget slugs and I'm going to need a bunch of those for the work ahead.

The closest place to get them is the Sludge Fen to the east.  The Venture Company usually keeps them in their tool buckets.  Go to the Sludge Fen and look in the tool buckets you find there, then return to me when you've gathered enough nugget slugs.
3922-accept.title: Nugget Slugs

3922-complete.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3922-complete.text: Great, you got them!  Now I can get to work...
3922-complete.title: Nugget Slugs

3922-progress.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3922-progress.text: Do you have the nugget slugs, $N?  I've been eyeing this Samophlange and I can't wait to tinker with it.
3922-progress.title: Nugget Slugs

3923-accept.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3923-accept.text:
Well, that didn't work.  I put some extra gauges on the samophlange to measure its structural integrity, and they read the integrity at an all-time low.  I could add some more dials and maybe a lever or two to try and fix it, but... I think that might make things even worse.

You should take the samophlange to Rilli Greasygob.  He used to work for the Venture Company -- if anyone knows how to fix it, it's Rilli.

You can find him at Nogg's Machine Shop in Orgrimmar, in the Valley of Honor.
3923-accept.title: Rilli Greasygob

4921-accept.name: Mankrik
4921-accept.text:
We battled in a small tauren camp when we were separated--she held three of the Bristlebacks off by herself. But the odds began to overwhelm us. I led some away only to see her overwhelmed by newcomers. In my rage, I turned to face my enemies, but they brought me down easily with their vast numbers.

I awoke to a tauren druid tending my wounds--he had come across me on the Gold Road as I fell.

Please, $c, find some sign of my wife.
4921-accept.title: Lost in Battle

5041-accept.name: Thork
5041-accept.text:
That attack on the caravan contained supplies we desperately needed.

You've been brave enough to take on the Razormane tribe so far, and I will ask you to do so again, but this time, I wonder if I could ask you to keep your eyes open for some of our lost supplies. You can probably find them throughout their camps, the quilboar getting fat off their dishonorable acts.

The people of the Crossroads would be in your debt.
5041-accept.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

5041-complete.name: Thork
5041-complete.text: Haha! Thank you, $N! This will help us greatly. You're a boon to the Crossroads and to the Horde. If there is anything I can do for you, please, let me know.
5041-complete.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

5041-progress.name: Thork
5041-progress.text: How goes your search for the supplies, $N? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.
5041-progress.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

529-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-complete.text: Mission accomplished, $c.  And carried out quite skillfully, I might add.
529-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-progress.text: Were you able to carry out your orders, $c?  Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants?  And where is that iron shipment?
529-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

532-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
532-accept.text:
The town of Hillsbrad is in disarray and we believe it will soon fall.  We must, however, persist in our ruthlessness until the human scum are wiped from the foothills for eternity.

Despite their overwhelming losses, the humans rally around their leadership and keep fighting.  We must eliminate their leader, Magistrate Burnside, as well as the town council.  Destroy their revered political document as well, the Hillsbrad Proclamation.  And while you're at it, steal the town registry.
532-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

544-accept.name: Magus Wordeen Voidglare
544-accept.text:
I came to Tarren Mill to research, but now must resolve a crisis. You see, four Forsaken fled the Undercity a few months ago. They turned their backs on their brethren, but what's worse...they stole from the Dark Lady.

These thieves broke into a secure vault and stole four artifacts, items our apothecaries required in certain studies. Sylvanas would have these artifacts returned.

The thieves fled the Undercity to Dalaran, and those wizards quarantined them in the Lordamere Internment Camp.
544-accept.title: Prison Break In

552-progress.name: Novice Thaivand
552-progress.text: Have you recovered Helcular's Rod yet?  There are so many Yeti in this region, it will be very difficult to locate.  But we must have it in order to proceed.
552-progress.title: Helcular's Revenge

553-accept.name: Novice Thaivand
553-accept.text:
Here, take the Rod of Helcular. You will need it.

Helcular fashioned 3 ceremonial pyres as part of his most powerful spell.  The Flame of Azel and the Flame of Veraz lie within the Foothill Caverns. The Flame of Uzel lies in a cave above the caverns, further north in the mountains.

The Rod of Helcular must be charged from each of the three flames. Once the ritual is complete, drive the rod into Helcular's grave in Southshore, the heavily guarded human town to the south.  Vengeance shall be ours!
553-accept.title: Helcular's Revenge

553-complete.name: Unknown
553-complete.text: A great rumbling emanates from the ground.
553-complete.title: Helcular's Revenge

553-progress.name: Unknown
553-progress.text: Helcular's grave teems with a mystical energy.
553-progress.title: Helcular's Revenge

556-accept.name: Keeper Bel'varil
556-accept.text:
A notable talent of the wizards of Dalaran is their familiarity with elementals: powerful creatures from other dimensions.  The wizards use magical tokens as a means to control these elementals.  Magus Voidglare would like some of these tokens to study.

Enter the territories of the Dalaran wizards, west of Hillsbrad, and gather the tokens.

You might find the tokens on any citizen of Dalaran, but I suggest hunting at the internment camp.  It's safer than Dalaran itself.
556-accept.title: Stone Tokens

567-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
567-complete.text: You are quite the bounty hunter, $c.  Well done.
567-complete.title: Dangerous!

5726-accept.name: Thrall
5726-accept.text:
One thing I will not tolerate are traitors in our midst, $N. But I would be a fool to play my hand so early--it would not sufficiently cut the corruption out of our lands and only cause the infection to grow worse.

But you, a young adventurer, could go places my agents could not... could learn the truth... could find the true head of the beast.

If you are brave enough, then enter Skull Rock to the east of Orgrimmar, find a lieutenant's insignia off one of the Burning Blade there, and return to me.
5726-accept.title: Hidden Enemies

6541-accept.name: Thork
6541-accept.text:
Have you ever been to Ashenvale, to the north? The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.

If you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern Barrens, at the watch tower. He is heading up the Ashenvale campaign and can give you further orders.
6541-accept.title: Report to Kadrak

6541-complete.name: Kadrak
6541-complete.text: Ashenvale is a divided land, but our most recent efforts have been very successful. We not only have an outpost at the Zoram Strand, but another just north of here called Splintertree.
6541-complete.title: Report to Kadrak

6543-accept.name: Kadrak
6543-accept.text:
I recently deployed a few scouts into Ashenvale and I need a runner to take them their orders, and bring me back a report of what they have observed.

Your first stop should be the Zoram'gar Outpost, along the coast to the west, at the Zoram Strand, to locate the first runner. You also need to stop at Splintertree Post, to the north, and along the road to the east, near Azshara. You will find a scout and an outrider there.

Give them each a report, and from them, get an update on their findings.
6543-accept.title: The Warsong Reports

769-accept.name: Veren Tallstrider
769-accept.text:
The kodo beasts of Mulgore are strong and sturdy -- traits much respected among us.  If you are skilled in leatherworking and wish the knowledge to make a Kodo Hide Bag, then bring me supplies for my trade.

Do this, and I will share my knowledge with you.
769-accept.title: Kodo Hide Bag

7826-progress.name: Rashona Straglash
7826-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Orgrimmar for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7826-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

844-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-accept.text:
Your first prey will be easy.

The plainstriders to the east have been harassing our food supplies and have become a nuisance.

Put down the plainstriders and return to me with their beaks.
844-accept.title: Plainstrider Menace

844-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-complete.text: Very good, $N.  With the plainstriders gone we'll have an easier time keeping our supply chains intact.  And I hope you learned a few tricks out there in the Barrens, for your next prey has a little more fire in its blood than the plainstriders...
844-complete.title: Plainstrider Menace

844-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-progress.text: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
844-progress.title: Plainstrider Menace

845-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-accept.text:
The zhevra, although not the fiercest beast in the Barrens, are a shade tougher than the plainstriders.  Don't worry -- we'll send you against bigger prey in good time, but for now your teeth could use a little more cutting.

Hunt the zhevra to the north and south, and collect their hooves.  Bring them to me and perhaps we'll next send you against something tougher.
845-accept.title: The Zhevra

845-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-complete.text:
Not bad, $N.  Those zhevra hold a lot of strength in their legs.  A sharp kick from them can knock even a tauren on its haunches!

It looks like you have some strength in you too.  Are you ready for a real challenge?
845-complete.title: The Zhevra

845-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-progress.text: How many zhevra have you slain?
845-progress.title: The Zhevra

848-accept.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-accept.text:
The oases of the Barrens hide a mystery.  Life energy flows from their waters, invigorating the plants and beasts that drink it.

Invigorating, and altering.

There is a mushroom that grows near these oases.  Its spores hold properties that we, the apothecaries of Lordaeron, find useful.

Bring me these spores and you will earn our gratitude.
848-accept.title: Fungal Spores

848-complete.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-complete.text:
Ah, yes.  These are good specimens.  Potent.

I am Forsaken, and we honor our contracts.  Here is your reward, $N.
848-complete.title: Fungal Spores

848-progress.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-progress.text: Do you have the spores, $N?  There is a concoction I must send to my associate in Thunder Bluff, which requires the spores...
848-progress.title: Fungal Spores

853-accept.name: Apothecary Helbrim
853-accept.text:
I have rendered the spores you gave me into an emulsion.  I must now send it to my associate, Apothecary Zamah.  If you were to carry this to her, she can offer you something from our stores of alchemical goods.

She is in the Pools of Vision, a cave beneath the shamans of Thunder Bluff.  The path to this cave is well hidden, but you may find it on the Spirit Rise bluff.

Do hurry.  This emulsion will maintain its potency for only a short time, and must be resealed and processed before then.
853-accept.title: Apothecary Zamah

853-complete.name: Apothecary Zamah
853-complete.text:
Ah, the spores from the Barrens that Helbrim was gathering.  He garnered your aid in delivering them?  Good.

And the emulsion is still potent, so you must have wasted no time in the delivery.  Well done, $c.
853-complete.title: Apothecary Zamah

853-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
853-progress.text: You have something from Apothecary Helbrim?
853-progress.title: Apothecary Zamah

865-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-accept.text:
The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands.  And I think all that smarts is hiding in their horns!  If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks."  I could sell them for a fortune!!!

And you can help me.  Find me intact raptor horns from sunscale scytheclaws.  They roam in the southern Barrens, and in the northern Barrens near the border of Ashenvale Forest.
865-accept.title: Raptor Horns

865-complete.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-complete.text: Great, you got them!  Now I just need to ground them down and mix them with some wine, and...
865-complete.title: Raptor Horns

865-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-progress.text: Did you get the horns, $N?  Those things are going to make me a fortune!
865-progress.title: Raptor Horns

867-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-accept.text:
The blasted harpies have been ravaging our caravan supplies for too long. It's time we slit a few of their throats and diminished their numbers.

I've been snooping around their nests and figured out who leads who. The most devastating attack will destroy a good section of their lower chain of command and then we can work our way to the top.

I'll start you off slow, take out Witchwing Harpies and Witchwing Roguefeathers in the Northwest and bring me 8 Witchwing talons. That should be a good start...
867-accept.title: Harpy Raiders

867-complete.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-complete.text: Oh, these are nice. Real nice... Good job, $N. I look forward to seeing more of your work in the future.
867-complete.title: Harpy Raiders

867-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-progress.text: Cut up enough of them yet? Keep slicing and taking trophies. I want 8 Witchwing talons.
867-progress.title: Harpy Raiders

868-accept.name: Korran
868-accept.text:
Hey, $N. I been sent to the Crossroads to watch over the land and take note of its happenings for my masters in Orgrimmar.

One object of my studies are the insect-like creatures found to the south in the Field of Giants. We know little of the creatures, so I be makin' it a point to discover more. They seem to have intelligence to them, more so than any normal animal.

Take this digging claw and collect some of the creatures' eggs from their mounds, but be careful: if alerted, they will attack you.
868-accept.title: Egg Hunt

869-accept.name: Gazrog
869-accept.text:
Not long ago, a shipment of silver was stolen from our guard tower.  It was meant as payroll to the Crossroads' guards, and we want that silver back.

The strange thing is... we caught one of the thieves on the night of the theft.  And... it was a raptor!  Unbelievable!

I don't know what raptors would want with silver.  But I don't care -- I want the raptors dead so they won't steal from us again!

Hunt raptors in the Barrens.  Collect for me their heads!
869-accept.title: Raptor Thieves

869-complete.name: Gazrog
869-complete.text:
You got rid of the raptors!

Thank you, $N.  You are a $c of worth.
869-complete.title: Raptor Thieves

870-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
870-accept.text:
Long ago, the Barrens was a lush place, teeming with life.  But war and cataclysm raged across the land, scorching it and leaving a dry husk.  Such is the way of things, and it saddens my heart.

But within the past few years, new oases have formed in the Barrens, and life stirs.  And deep down, we druids sense a power leaking its way to the surface.

We must find its source.  Travel to the Forgotten Pools, northwest of the Crossroads.  Search its waters for a source of power, then return here.
870-accept.title: The Forgotten Pools

870-complete.name: Tonga Runetotem
870-complete.text:
You found a fissure in the earth, with gases bubbling from it?  Strange.  This may be an answer to our questions, but we cannot yet be sure.

But it is a clue.  And I am grateful that you found it.
870-complete.title: The Forgotten Pools

871-accept.name: Thork
871-accept.text:
All the quilboars are our enemies, $N. Some just prove to be more of a nuisance than others.

The Razormane tribe has been attacking our supply lines from Durotar, causing us no end of annoyance. I have scouts seeking the leader of these raids, but until then, any losses you can inflict on the filthy pig men would aid us.

Start in the northeast towards Durotar. You can always tell their dens from the huge thorny vines that come up from the earth. Seek them out, and slay them.
871-accept.title: Disrupt the Attacks

871-complete.name: Thork
871-complete.text: You have done well, $N. Those insolent quilboars will finally learn that the might of the Horde is not to be ignored.
871-complete.title: Disrupt the Attacks

872-accept.name: Thork
872-accept.text:
One of my scouts witnessed an attack on a caravan from Durotar, $N. The culprits are indeed the Razormane tribe of quilboars. One of the quilboars in particular is leading the raids: Kreenig Snarlsnout. He was seen northeast of here, just south of the road from Durotar. If the threat is to be ended, then Kreenig must die.

To be sure the attacks cease, though, I say we add insult to their injury. Kill Kreenig along with more of their tribe, and return to me when you have his tusk.
872-accept.title: The Disruption Ends

872-complete.name: Thork
872-complete.text:
Well done, $N. With Kreenig's death, there will be a definite decline in the attacks on our caravans.

Your people should be proud to count you among them.
872-complete.title: The Disruption Ends

872-progress.name: Thork
872-progress.text:
Cut off the head of their leader, and chaos ensues, $N. Learn this lesson well. It will aid you in the future.

The boars will flounder without direction, and we will be able to take back the Barrens.
872-progress.title: The Disruption Ends

875-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-accept.text:
Hahaha, $N. Back for more? Good, I like to hear that.

This time I want you to assassinate some of the harpy lieutenants in the Dry Hills. Only Witchwing Slayers can be lieutenants, and you can tell them apart by the rings they carry. They are a nasty bunch, but they lead some of the underlings in that area. Taking out 6 of them will be a decisive strike against their matriarchy.

Make sure they die painfully, $N. We want those harpy wenches to know the idiocy of picking fights with the Horde.
875-accept.title: Harpy Lieutenants

875-complete.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-complete.text: Excellent work my friend. I think you'll go far within the Horde.
875-complete.title: Harpy Lieutenants

875-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-progress.text: Do you have 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings yet? Justice must be dealt to them for their vicious attacks on the Horde.
875-progress.title: Harpy Lieutenants

876-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
876-accept.text:
You did so well with the lieutenants and underlings that I'd like you to do one last thing for me.

Serena Bloodfeather is the sister of a harpy named Bloodfeather who was slain by Rexxar quite a while ago. Apparently, these attacks on the Horde caravans are revenge for her sister's death.

I need you to slit her throat and bring me back her head. I want to place it on the next caravan we send out... Give those harpies something to think about.
876-accept.title: Serena Bloodfeather

877-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
877-accept.text:
Like the one you found at the Forgotten Pools, there may be fissures at the other oases in the Barrens.  If so, then perhaps the fissures are the oases' source of life.

We must test this.

Here, take these seeds.  They are dead and infertile, but take them to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast.  If there is a fissure there, then place the seeds within it...and observe.
877-accept.title: The Stagnant Oasis

878-accept.name: Mangletooth
878-accept.text:
You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> It gives us strength in all things... especially war.

If you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.
878-accept.title: Tribes at War

881-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
881-accept.text:
Whitemist, Echeyakee in the Tauren tongue, is the king of the savannah cats.  He hunts with such stealth, they say he's like a thin, white mist on the earth.  And he kills so fast his prey have no time for fear, or pain.

The Tauren say he is both mercy and death.

You will learn if that's true, for I now set you on the path to hunt Echeyakee.  His lair is northeast of the Crossroads, among the bones of giant Kodo

Go.  Blow this horn when you reach his lair.  Blow the horn, and he will come.
881-accept.title: Echeyakee

887-accept.name: Gazlowe
887-accept.text:
I sure wish Vice Admiral Grezzlik did a better job of keeping the seas safe for our trading vessels. With all the gold the trade princes have poured into the Trade Fleets, it ticks me off to see so many pirates running willy-nilly, raiding my ships and stealing my goods!

I heard that the Southsea Freebooters have set up a camp just south of here. They've been a real thorn in my side and if Grezzlik won't take care of them, well, maybe you can help me get rid of them.
887-accept.title: Southsea Freebooters

887-complete.name: Gazlowe
887-complete.text:
You did good, kid. A little more work like that, and it'll be one less thing I'll have to worry about. Hopefully they'll be convinced that they should relocate their operation elsewhere.

In the meantime, there is the small matter of getting back the goods they stole from me!
887-complete.title: Southsea Freebooters

888-accept.name: Gazlowe
888-accept.text:
While I'd like to recover all my goods, I'm sure that's not possible. Still, there's a few things that I absolutely must have!

As you see, my observatory is ready to go, but it needs the smaller of the two lenses. The first arrived by caravan from Durotar, but the second was bound by ship, and never arrived. Also, I never got my boot shipment from Drizzlik in Booty Bay!

Head down to the pirate camp and see if you can find them.
888-accept.title: Stolen Booty

890-accept.name: Gazlowe
890-accept.text:
I've been waiting forever for my last shipment of goods from Booty Bay! I'm pretty sure that it must have been stolen by the Freebooters, but just to make sure, will you go down to the dockside and ask Dizzywig if my goods were already put into my warehouse without my knowledge?

Here, take my ledger down to Dizzywig and have him double check my inventory records against his logs.
890-accept.title: The Missing Shipment

890-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-complete.text:
Ah, Gazlowe sent you, did he? Just a moment, let me take a look here and check my own logs and make sure I didn't have Gazlowe's shipment sent to the wrong place.

Bet he's waiting for those boots from Drizzlek...
890-complete.title: The Missing Shipment

890-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-progress.text: Wares to send on the next ship, $N?
890-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

891-accept.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-accept.text:
Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans at Northwatch Hold!

Those bastards must be dealt with. Their paranoia has them in a state of frenzy. Trigger happy, reckless louts are shooting at anything in their sights.

Travel south along the Merchant Coast to the Hold and lay siege to their forces. Bring me the medals of their soldiers as proof. And for the love of my fleet, slay Captain Fairmount and her overzealous cannoneers!
891-accept.title: The Guns of Northwatch

892-accept.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
892-accept.text:
Everything looks square from my records, $N. Go on back and tell Gazlowe he's out of luck. I wouldn't be surprised if it was the pirates that nabbed his goodies.

Nothing else I can do for him. Oh... though you could tell him that I've got some things from Undermine for him, when he has the time to come pick them up.
892-accept.title: The Missing Shipment

892-complete.name: Gazlowe
892-complete.text:
No dice, eh? I guess it must have been the Freebooters then... Dizzywig's on the level, I'm sure he wouldn't cheat me like that. After all, he is on the payroll.

Looks like I've got some goods to get back, $N. What do you say?
892-complete.title: The Missing Shipment

892-progress.name: Gazlowe
892-progress.text: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
892-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

893-accept.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-accept.text:
The Razormane quilboars to the south, beyond the Field of Giants, have no skilled blacksmiths from what I am told, but they've apparently started to develop sturdier weapons. I'd like to get my hands on a few different types to learn their techniques if possible.

If you wish to help bring honor to the Horde, then bring me examples of their weapons. Find me a dagger from their stalkers, a wand from their seers, and a shield from their warfrenzy. That should do nicely!
893-accept.title: Weapons of Choice

894-accept.name: Sputtervalve
894-accept.text:
The Venture Company set up a small research facility far to the north of here, southwest of the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".

Now what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.

I obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
894-accept.title: Samophlange

894-complete.name: Unknown
894-complete.text: A variety of buttons, levers and blinking lights are somewhat erratically arrayed on the face of the control console. A small gauge indicates that the apparatus is currently operating within optimal levels, and indicates that control valves one through three are currently open. There is a small keyhole set into the lower right side of the control panel.
894-complete.title: Samophlange

895-accept.name: Unknown
895-accept.text:
WANTED!

Baron Longshore, Captain of the Heedless

Captain Longshore of Gilneas leads vessels of the Southsea Freebooters, and is wanted on charges of piracy. Remains must be in identifiable condition!

-- Gazlowe
895-accept.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

895-complete.name: Gazlowe
895-complete.text:
Ahhhh! That sort of business. You know, I saw the Heedless once on the open seas. Fearsome ship, or was that boat... those sailors are so particular!

Anyways, watching her glide across the water was quite a sight to see. I'm glad her infamous captain will trouble my ships no longer.
895-complete.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

896-accept.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-accept.text:
Being Wharfmaster of a busy port like Ratchet, I keep my finger on the pulse of information. I know all about the exchange of goods and money between here and Booty Bay.

The latest bit of news I've heard is about the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine northeast of the Sludge Fen. One of the miners discovered an emerald the size of your fist. I know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale.
896-accept.title: Miner's Fortune

896-complete.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-complete.text:
Look at the size of that thing, $N! We're going to be rich! Let's see, according to the rates I've seen on gems going into Undermine, I should be able to figure out your cut--fifty percent, don't worry!

Now let's see... I think this should do about right. Pleasure doing business with you, $N.
896-complete.title: Miner's Fortune

896-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
896-progress.text: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...
896-progress.title: Miner's Fortune

899-accept.name: Mankrik
899-accept.text:
Perhaps you know the pain of uncertainty, perhaps not, $c. But know this: I stand here every day, from the sun's rising till its decline, scouring the horizon for more of those monsters. I've killed every pig man I've come across since, but my thirst for their blood is far from quenched. Perhaps instead of heading north to the Crossroads I should have headed to Taurajo.

You, $c--you  could help me.

Kill them. Kill as many as you can. Bring me their tusks, and we will celebrate their deaths together.
899-accept.title: Consumed by Hatred

899-complete.name: Mankrik
899-complete.text:
$C, you take my task seriously, and for that I thank you.

Although my desire for revenge remains, I can at least smile seeing that the quilboars have felt pain themselves.
899-complete.title: Consumed by Hatred

899-progress.name: Mankrik
899-progress.text: The quilboar will pay for this, $N. I swear it.
899-progress.title: Consumed by Hatred

900-accept.name: Unknown
900-accept.text: The three control valves are currently opened. The various readings on the control panel lead you to presume that they must be shut off before the apparatus can be shut off.
900-accept.title: Samophlange

900-complete.name: Unknown
900-complete.text: The lights indicating the three control valves dim as they are shut off. Green lights slowly fade into yellow, and the switch controlling the apparatus is now moveable, with the valves closed, it can be turned off.
900-complete.title: Samophlange

901-accept.name: Unknown
901-accept.text: With the apparatus deactivated, the control panel can be opened up and the samophlange removed from the console. With everything else in place, all that is left is to acquire the key to unlock the console.
901-accept.title: Samophlange

901-complete.name: Unknown
901-complete.text: Turning the key in the lock, the control console unlocks. A red light at the top of the console turns off and all power drains from the terminal.
901-complete.title: Samophlange

901-progress.name: Unknown
901-progress.text: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.
901-progress.title: Samophlange

902-accept.name: Unknown
902-accept.text: Pulling open the face of the control console reveals a dense jumble of wires, tubing and other strange mechanical objects--most of which seem to serve no practical purpose. Pushing them aside and digging deeper into the console, you find the samophlange. A tug removes it from its housing.
902-accept.title: Samophlange

902-complete.name: Sputtervalve
902-complete.text:
This is... er... interesting... yes. I'll have it sent along to the Tinkers' Union headquarters in Undermine. I'm sure after some careful dissection and research, they'll be able to make some sense of it.

But, perhaps I'll have a little look myself first...
902-complete.title: Samophlange

902-progress.name: Sputtervalve
902-progress.text: Oh, you're back, $N! Do you have the samophlange?
902-progress.title: Samophlange

903-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-accept.text:
Now it's time to go after something that really bites.  The prowlers of the Barrens are a tough breed.  Tough, resourceful, sly... and deadly.  You'll find them among the tall grasses.  You'll find many to the southwest of the Crossroads.

Be wary as you hunt them, $N, or you may find yourself no longer the predator, but instead the prey.
903-accept.title: Prowlers of the Barrens

903-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-complete.text: Ah, I see you've been busy, lurking in the grasses and hunting prowlers.  Do you think, then, it is time to face a champion among them?
903-complete.title: Prowlers of the Barrens

903-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-progress.text: How goes your hunt, $N?  Have you found the prowlers?
903-progress.title: Prowlers of the Barrens

92640-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
92640-accept.text:
Since engaging the cult in the open is not viable, our best chance is going to be to use this opportunity to attack the shrine itself. We can take Lorthuna herself off the board before she can finish her part of this scheme.

It so happens that Valennia has been preparing a strategy for a potential assault on the Shrine for some time now. The only problem is, we will need help. 

Speak with Valennia for the details.
92640-accept.title: Desperate Times

92640-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92640-complete.text: Tensions between the Windshapers and High Order are high right now, but we couldn't hope to carry out this plan without both groups on board.
92640-complete.title: Desperate Times

92642-accept.name: Yorana Windyreed
92642-accept.text:
Valennia only sent one person to help repel a full-scale assault... by the winds.

You don't look like much but I'll take what I can get. We need to inflict as much damage as possible to stop this soon. My people can't hold out much longer.

Go down the hill and disrupt their logistics. Their healers are keeping the attackers coming, if we take them out we might be able to rally and push them back. Any other cultists you kill while you are out there are helpful as well.
92642-accept.title: Disrupting Logistics

92642-complete.name: Yorana Windyreed
92642-complete.text: You are still alive? Thank the winds for small miracles, I suppose.
92642-complete.title: Disrupting Logistics

92643-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
92643-accept.text:
There is a turncoat amongst the Al'Aketh. They claim to know the cult's true intentions for the island and want to come in, but will only do so with assurances of protection.

This defector is hiding at a secluded residence just northwest of Valanaar inside the highlands. I need someone who can discreetly go there, find the traitor, and escort him back to us. This might be a trap, but if this information is as important as this traitor claims, it's worth some risk.
92643-accept.title: The Turncoat

92643-complete.name: Dead Cultist
92643-complete.text: <This man is clearly dead, killed by the assassins that you fought outside the house. As you kneel down to inspect the body you notice the glinting reflection of something shiny...>
92643-complete.title: The Turncoat

92644-accept.name: Dead Cultist
92644-accept.text: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>
92644-accept.title: Unfortunate News

92644-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
92644-complete.text:
The turncoat was already dead when you arrived, you say? This is unfortunate news.

<You hand over the crystal you found on the dead cultist's body.>

Interesting...
92644-complete.title: Unfortunate News

92645-accept.name: Yorana Windyreed
92645-accept.text:
This attack is going to be hard to repel unless we can take out the cult commander. Belguilos "the Breaker" they call her, and she's a veritable terror. She used to be a peacekeeper before the cult got out of control, and even then she was... off. As a cultist I can only imagine how much worse she could be now.

I might just be sending you to your death, but someone needs to take Belguilos out if we are going to survive here. You can find her at the villa at the hill's base. Good luck, $c.
92645-accept.title: Breaking the Breaker

92645-complete.name: Yorana Windyreed
92645-complete.text:
Belguilos is dead? Four winds bless you, $c. 

We might just make it out of this alive after all.
92645-complete.title: Breaking the Breaker

92646-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
92646-accept.text:
Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago.

I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Ayessa and help them stop Lorthuna.

Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, $c.
92646-accept.title: Confront Lorthuna

92646-complete.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
92646-complete.text:
I sent a few of our healers to ensure that Valennia and her remaining forces made it back in one piece. She should be resting in the High Elder's residence now.

Muln has already departed back to Azeroth, but he and I spoke of what is next for the Windshapers and our mission to Azeroth. Unfortunately, the island is more vulnerable than ever now and we need a plan to protect Zephras from what is to come.
92646-complete.title: Confront Lorthuna

92679-accept.name: Alvarion Windfield
92679-accept.text:
H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I...

<The $R man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain>

...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
92679-accept.title: Blood Tithe

92679-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92679-complete.text:
<Aamelia listens while you explain what became of Alvarion.>

At least I know he's going to be safe in Valanaar.

Stranger, I hate to tell you this but I think my idiot husband likely just sent you here to die for nothing. If you have any sense at all, you should leave now. This isn't your fight.
92679-complete.title: Blood Tithe

92682-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92682-accept.text:
Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue.

Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive.

Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. 

Let's see what you've got in a fight.
92682-accept.title: Make Yourself Useful

92682-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92682-complete.text: I watched you take down those bandits from the window. Not bad.
92682-complete.title: Make Yourself Useful

92682-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92682-progress.text: These bandits are more likely to double cross and steal from each other than they are to steal from normal folks. I bet if Ferauu knew some of his people went rogue and came here early to tamper with the harvest, he'd kill them himself.
92682-progress.title: Make Yourself Useful

92683-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92683-accept.text:
I'm sure you've noticed the giant flutterflies out in the outer fields near the orchard? They are pleasant to look at, but they also have other benefits; namely their wing dust. It can be a mess, but if you can gather it up in large amounts, it has useful household applications.

Take this Flutterfly Swatter and give the big bugs a good swat for me. They'll usually just get scared and flee, but sometimes they'll take some offense. Either way, they'll give their rumps a shake and drop a pile of dust.
92683-accept.title: Flutterfly Dust

92683-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92683-complete.text:
This stuff can be a bit messy and it tends to get everywhere. You'll probably be shaking this out of your trousers for weeks, unfortunately. I do appreciate it, though. I've had this on my to-do list for weeks, but getting too far from the house when it's just me on my own with bandits lurking everywhere is a big risk.

Don't bother asking me what I use this stuff for. Things. Stuff and things. Don't worry about it.
92683-complete.title: Flutterfly Dust

92683-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92683-progress.text: Flutterflies are normally docile and calm, but rub them the wrong way and sometimes they'll surprise you.
92683-progress.title: Flutterfly Dust

92684-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92684-accept.text:
As if the harvest wasn't light enough this year already, the galestriders in the area have been getting into the orchard and stealing my stormapples. Think you can head out to the fields and cull them for me?

Take care though stranger, these lowlands galestriders are bigger and angrier than the highlands variety. Watch yourself. A well-timed kick is all it takes to put you down for good if you aren't paying attention.

Bring me some of their meat and I can make us a hot meal with it as well.
92684-accept.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92684-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92684-complete.text: These are big tenderloins! You must have taken down some real monsters out there.
92684-complete.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92684-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92684-progress.text: I don't think I've had real meat for dinner in... well, too long.
92684-progress.title: Ornery Ornery Galestriders

92685-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92685-accept.text:
The bandits have camps all over and there's a small one in the hills just north of here. Head up there and start cracking skulls. If we can catch them off guard and take them out before they come for us, we might just even the odds enough to stand a chance.

Bring me their masks. The bloodier the better.
92685-accept.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92685-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92685-complete.text:
When I said the bloodier the better, you really listened. Good. It lets me know you made it hurt.

On a serious note, thank you for what you've done so far. I've been floating aimlessly around this farm for weeks as if I was just waiting for the end to come. I think I'm starting to have hope again.

Ferauu and his thugs are due any time now. All that's left is to go out and face them. What do you say, will you see this through to the end with me?
92685-complete.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92685-progress.name: Aamelia Windfield
92685-progress.text:
If you manage to bring me enough bandit masks, maybe I'll stitch a blanket out of them and give it to Ferauu.

<Aamelia laughs loudly.>
92685-progress.title: The Hills Have Eyes

92693-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-accept.text:
You've done a lot to give us a fighting chance. Even if we die today, we'll at least know we gave it our best shot.

This is your last chance, stranger. If you want to head back to Valanaar and live another day, I wouldn't blame you.

On the other hand, if you really have a thing for lost causes just let me know when you are ready to go. We'll walk out there with our heads held high and whatever happens, happens.
92693-accept.title: Standing Our Ground

92693-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92693-complete.text: I... can't believe it's over. I need to stop and calm myself before my heart leaps right out of my chest.
92693-complete.title: Standing Our Ground

92698-accept.name: Malfunctioning Cyclone Construct
92698-accept.text:
<You lean in close to try and hear the words coming from beneath the giant construct's armor plates.>

...Function error...

...Question...

...What is....

...Function...

<These fragmented words and phrases seem to just repeat. Maybe someone nearby knows more about this construct?>
92698-accept.title: What Is My Purpose?

92698-complete.name: Aamelia Windfield
92698-complete.text:
The construct? It's been wandering around the fields for decades. Since the wind elementals left us, I think. Alvarion suspected that it used to haul harvests to market, or maybe tend to livestock back before this was an orchard. That could have been a thousand years ago though.

In the old days, the Windshapers used to maintain these constructs. We've talked about petitioning them to come and take a look at it, but it's never been a pressing concern to us. Mostly we just ignore it these days.
92698-complete.title: What Is My Purpose?

92703-accept.name: Aamelia Windfield
92703-accept.text:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, $N. 

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.
92703-accept.title: Deliver the News

92703-complete.name: Alvarion Windfield
92703-complete.text:
<Alvarion's eyes tear up as you finish retelling the story of what happened at the orchard.>

I don't know how to thank you, friend. I came to Valanaar looking for hope. A vain hope, I was almost certain. But instead I found a hero. A real hero, like the stories from before we came to Skywall. 

I'll never forget what you did for us, $N. You'll always be welcome at the Windfield home.
92703-complete.title: Deliver the News

92706-accept.name: Unknown
92706-accept.text:
Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

-- Gazlowe
92706-accept.title: WANTED: Bruuz

92706-complete.name: Gazlowe
92706-complete.text:
Finally, somebody killed that thing! Do you know how hard it is to get a crew in the water when everyone in town's crying "Shark!" all the time?

I might just put that monster's fin into a soup for dinner tonight, just to have the last laugh.
92706-complete.title: WANTED: Bruuz

92706-progress.name: Gazlowe
92706-progress.text: What can I do for ya, $r?
92706-progress.title: WANTED: Bruuz

92871-accept.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
92871-accept.text:
Valennia Stormfist and her peacekeepers have ever been the protectors of Zephras, and we've done our best to lend aid where we can. There are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island, and they are clearly gearing up for something.

Report to Valennia and reiterate to her that the Windshapers offer their full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92871-accept.title: In Service of Zephras

92871-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92871-complete.text: You seem eager to lend aid immediately. Come, let's speak further on the current situation.
92871-complete.title: In Service of Zephras

92880-accept.name: Yorana Windyreed
92880-accept.text:
I suspect it will take a bit of time for us to mop up what's left of the attackers, but our chances are far better now. Head back to Valanaar and let them know that we are stable here now.

I can't thank you enough for your help. We'd be in much worse shape without you. I asked for reinforcements and it seems that I got a burgeoning hero instead. I'll take that.

May the four winds bless you, $c.
92880-accept.title: Return to Valanaar

92880-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
92880-complete.text:
<Valennia looks visibly relieved as you tell her about the status of the eastern watchtower.>

Thank the winds.
92880-complete.title: Return to Valanaar

92881-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
92881-accept.text:
The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.

Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.
92881-accept.title: The High Elder's Request

92881-complete.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
92881-complete.text: I have a small matter that requires just the kind of assistance that an adventurer like yourself can provide.
92881-complete.title: The High Elder's Request

92947-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
92947-accept.text:
Everyone is here, good. I've just sent a few of my best fighters in through the front of the shrine to cause a bit of trouble and serve as a distraction, while I lead the the bulk of our forces in from the flank.

If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, $c.
92947-accept.title: Making Our Move

92947-complete.name: Hyusaa Quickbreeze
92947-complete.text: We fought hard to get this far but it isn't over yet.
92947-complete.title: Making Our Move

93065-accept.name: Valennia Stormfist
93065-accept.text: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.
93065-accept.title: Prepare for Battle

93065-complete.name: Valennia Stormfist
93065-complete.text: We are as ready as we'll ever be.
93065-complete.title: Prepare for Battle

93090-accept.name: Talaanis Shadowsong
93090-accept.text:
Please extend my thanks to Ayessa for all that the Windshapers and your new friends from this "Earthen Ring" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the plan to take the Windshapers' shamans and leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever solution the Windshapers find can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years.

Winds be with you, $N.
93090-accept.title: What Comes Next

93090-complete.name: Ayessa Dawnsinger
93090-complete.text:
I'm pleased to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.

Muln has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between Zephras Isle and a place called Mulgore, where the Earthen Ring make their home. We've been doing test voyages and some of our people are already waiting on the other side.
93090-complete.title: What Comes Next

93160-complete.name: Strange Hermit
93160-complete.text:
Thank you, stranger! You'll find that these are delicious once roasted! 

Please excuse me, it won't take me long to whip this up.
93160-complete.title: The Forest's Bounty

93160-progress.name: Strange Hermit
93160-progress.text: Mmm, I think you are going to like what I can cook up with these acorns!
93160-progress.title: The Forest's Bounty

93165-accept.name: Vayn Moongaze
93165-accept.text:
